# CSMA aiui Catalog: generation loop demo

Source: demo/aiui-catalog.html

# aiui Catalog: the generation loop
## Core seed components (owner: core)
## Module surfaces (owner: module)
- This page proves the compose half of the CSMA component workflow: every
      gallery card below is mounted through `AIUIComposerService`
      from the generated `componentCatalog`, the same path slides
      and archetypes use.
     
     
       `npm run create-component  `: scaffolds manifest + CSS + preview in `src/ui/components/ /`
- Edit the generated manifest / props to fit the brief
- `npm run generate-ai-ui-catalog`: regenerates the catalog (generated artifact, never hand-edited)
- Compose via the composer / aiui ops, as this page does
- `npm run check:design` + `npm run check:styles` gates
CSMA aiui Catalog: generation loop demo Mounted live via `composer.compose({ component: id, props })`.

Registered but not mounted here: they need their owning module's service via `ServiceManager`. See the slides demo for the full `mountSurface` path.

import { createNavTabs } from '../src/modules/archetypes/nav-tabs/index.js'; import { createOverlayManager } from '../src/modules/archetypes/overlay-manager/index.js'; const log = (id, msg) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = msg; }; const PEOPLE = [ { id: 1, name: 'Alice', age: 30, role: 'Engineer' }, { id: 2, name: 'Bob', age: 25, role: 'Designer' }, { id: 3, name: 'Charlie', age: 35, role: 'Manager' }, { id: 4, name: 'Diana', age: 28, role: 'Engineer' }, { id: 5, name: 'Eve', age: 32, role: 'Designer' }, { id: 6, name: 'Frank', age: 40, role: 'Manager' }, { id: 7, name: 'Grace', age: 22, role: 'Intern' }, { id: 8, name: 'Hank', age: 45, role: 'Director' }, { id: 9, name: 'Iris', age: 29, role: 'Engineer' }, { id: 10, name: 'Jack', age: 33, role: 'Designer' }, { id: 11, name: 'Kate', age: 27, role: 'Manager' }, { id: 12, name: 'Leo', age: 31, role: 'Engineer' }, ]; // ─── Data Grid ──────────────────────────────────── const grid = createDataGrid(document.getElementById('grid-container'), (evt, payload) => { log('grid-log', `[${evt}] ${JSON.stringify(payload).slice(0, 100)}`); }, { columns: [ { id: 'name', label: 'Name', width: 180, sortable: true }, { id: 'age', label: 'Age', width: 80, sortable: true }, { id: 'role', label: 'Role', width: 160 }, ], data: PEOPLE, resizable: true, rowHeight: 36, }); document.getElementById('dg-sort-name').onclick = () => grid.sort('name'); document.getElementById('dg-sort-age').onclick = () => grid.sort('age'); document.getElementById('dg-loading').onclick = () => grid.setLoading(true); document.getElementById('dg-empty').onclick = () => grid.update([]); document.getElementById('dg-error').onclick = () => { grid.setLoading(false); grid.update([]); document.getElementById('grid-container').querySelector('.csma-datagrid').dataset.state = 'error'; }; document.getElementById('dg-update').onclick = () => grid.update([{ id: 100, name: 'New Alice', age: 31, role: 'VP' }, { id: 101, name: 'New Bob', age: 26, role: 'CTO' }]); // Multi-select grid const gridSel = createDataGrid(document.getElementById('grid-selectable-container'), null, { columns: [{ id: 'name', label: 'Name', width: 200 }, { id: 'role', label: 'Role', width: 180 }], data: PEOPLE.slice(0, 6), selectable: true, multiSelect: true, rowHeight: 40, onSelectionChange: (ids) => log('grid-selectable-log', `Selected: [${ids.join(', ')}]`), }); document.getElementById('dg-get-selected').onclick = () => log('grid-selectable-log', `API: ${JSON.stringify(gridSel.getSelected())}`); // ─── Stats Dashboard + Chart.js ─────────────────── let chartInstances = []; function randomData() { return { total: { value: 800 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1200), trend: Math.round((Math.random() - 0.3) * 30) }, active: { value: 300 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 800), trend: Math.round((Math.random() - 0.5) * 20) }, storage: { value: (1.5 + Math.random() * 4) * 1e9, trend: Math.round((Math.random() - 0.2) * 15) }, uptime: { value: 99 + Math.random(), trend: Math.round((Math.random() - 0.6) * 2) }, }; } function destroyCharts() { chartInstances.forEach(c => c.destroy()); chartInstances = []; } function renderCharts() { destroyCharts(); const container = document.getElementById('stats-container'); const canvases = container.querySelectorAll('.csma-stats__chart-canvas'); if (canvases.length { const rect = c.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) { c.width = rect.width * devicePixelRatio; c.height = rect.height * devicePixelRatio; } }); // Chart 1: Daily Events (line) const labels = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun']; chartInstances.push(new Chart(canvases[0], { type: 'line', data: { labels, datasets: [{ label: 'Events', data: labels.map(() => 20 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 80)), borderColor: primary, backgroundColor: 'transparent', tension: 0.3, pointRadius: 3, }], }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false } }, scales: { y: { beginAtZero: true, ticks: { font: { size: 10 } }, grid: { color: gridColor } }, x: { ticks: { font: { size: 10 } }, grid: { display: false } }, }, }, })); // Chart 2: Usage Breakdown (doughnut) chartInstances.push(new Chart(canvases[1], { type: 'doughnut', data: { labels: ['Compute', 'Storage', 'Network', 'Other'], datasets: [{ data: [45, 25, 18, 12], backgroundColor: [primary, accent, info, muted], borderWidth: 0, }], }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { font: { size: 10 }, padding: 12 } } }, }, })); } function waitForCanvases(retries = 15) { const canvases = document.querySelectorAll('.csma-stats__chart-canvas'); if (canvases.length >= 2) { requestAnimationFrame(() => { requestAnimationFrame(() => renderCharts()); }); } else if (retries > 0) { setTimeout(() => waitForCanvases(retries - 1), 150); } } const stats = createStatsDashboard(document.getElementById('stats-container'), (evt, p) => { log('stats-log', `[${evt}] ${JSON.stringify(p).slice(0, 100)}`); }, { cards: [ { id: 'total', label: 'Total Items', format: 'number', fetch: async () => randomData().total }, { id: 'active', label: 'Active Users', format: 'number', fetch: async () => randomData().active }, { id: 'storage', label: 'Storage Used', format: 'bytes', fetch: async () => randomData().storage }, { id: 'uptime', label: 'Uptime', format: 'percent', fetch: async () => randomData().uptime }, ], charts: [ { id: 'daily', label: 'Daily Events', type: 'line' }, { id: 'usage', label: 'Usage Breakdown', type: 'doughnut' }, ], }); waitForCanvases(); const refreshCharts = () => { stats.refresh(); setTimeout(() => waitForCanvases(8), 300); }; document.getElementById('sd-refresh').onclick = refreshCharts; document.getElementById('sd-randomize').onclick = refreshCharts; // ─── Viewer ─────────────────────────────────────── const viewer = createViewer(document.getElementById('viewer-container'), (evt, p) => { log('viewer-log', `[${evt}] ${JSON.stringify(p).slice(0, 100)}`); }, { markdown: 'auto' }); viewer.update(`# Hello World This is a **markdown** viewer with *italic*, \`inline code\`, and [links](https://example.com). ## Features - Renders headings, lists, and blocks - Supports code blocks - Handles images and links > Blockquote: archetypes are reusable ### Code \`\`\`js const msg = 'hello csma'; console.log(msg); \`\`\` `); document.getElementById('vw-update-md').onclick = () => viewer.update('## Updated\n\nNew **markdown** content.'); document.getElementById('vw-update-html').onclick = () => viewer.update({ html: ' Rendered from **API**.

' }); document.getElementById('vw-loading').onclick = () => viewer.setLoading(true); document.getElementById('vw-empty').onclick = () => viewer.update(''); const viewerPlain = createViewer(document.getElementById('viewer-plain-container'), null, { markdown: false, emptyMessage: 'Nothing here yet', }); viewerPlain.update('Plain text content with no markdown applied. Safe by default via textContent.'); // ─── Editor Builder ─────────────────────────────── const editor = createEditor(document.getElementById('editor-container'), (evt, p) => { log('editor-log', `[${evt}] ${JSON.stringify(p).slice(0, 100)}`); }, { fields: [ { id: 'name', type: 'text', label: 'Name', required: true, placeholder: 'Enter name' }, { id: 'email', type: 'email', label: 'Email', required: true }, { id: 'role', type: 'select', label: 'Role', options: ['Engineer', 'Designer', 'Manager'] }, { id: 'bio', type: 'textarea', label: 'Bio', help: 'Optional' }, { id: 'notify', type: 'toggle', label: 'Notifications' }, ], onSave: async (data) => { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); log('editor-log', 'Saved: ' + JSON.stringify(data).slice(0, 120)); }, draftKey: 'demo-editor', }); document.getElementById('eb-set-values').onclick = () => editor.setValues({ name: 'Alice', email: 'alice@example.com', role: 'Engineer', bio: 'Senior engineer', notify: true }); document.getElementById('eb-submit').onclick = () => editor.submit(); document.getElementById('eb-reset').onclick = () => editor.reset(); // ─── Config Panel ───────────────────────────────── const config = createConfigPanel(document.getElementById('config-container'), (evt, p) => { log('config-log', `[${evt}] ${JSON.stringify(p).slice(0, 100)}`); }, { sections: [ { label: 'Appearance', controls: [ { id: 'theme', type: 'select', label: 'Theme', options: ['Light', 'Dark', 'System'] }, { id: 'density', type: 'slider', label: 'Density', min: 1, max: 10, value: 5 }, { id: 'animations', type: 'toggle', label: 'Animations', value: true }, ], }, { label: 'Notifications', controls: [ { id: 'emailNotifs', type: 'toggle', label: 'Email', value: true }, { id: 'pushNotifs', type: 'toggle', label: 'Push', value: false }, ], }, { label: 'Advanced', collapsed: true, controls: [ { id: 'apiKey', type: 'text', label: 'API Key', placeholder: 'sk-...' }, { id: 'endpoint', type: 'text', label: 'Endpoint', placeholder: 'https://api.example.com' }, ], }, ], onChange: (id, value) => { log('config-log', `${id}: ${JSON.stringify(value)}`); if (id === 'theme') { if (value === 'Dark') document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'dark'; else if (value === 'Light') document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'light'; else delete document.documentElement.dataset.theme; } }, }); document.getElementById('cp-get-values').onclick = () => log('config-log', JSON.stringify(config.getValues())); document.getElementById('cp-set-values').onclick = () => config.setValues({ theme: 'Dark', density: '8', animations: false, emailNotifs: false }); // ─── Media Browser ──────────────────────────────── const mediaItems = [ { id: 'img1', name: 'sunset-beach.jpg', type: 'image', size: 2.4e6, date: 'Jan 15', src: 'data:image/svg+xml,' + encodeURIComponent(' ') }, { id: 'img2', name: 'mountain-lake.png', type: 'image', size: 5.1e6, date: 'Feb 20', src: 'data:image/svg+xml,' + encodeURIComponent(' ') }, { id: 'vid1', name: 'product-demo.mp4', type: 'video', size: 48e6, date: 'Mar 10' }, { id: 'doc1', name: 'Q4-report.pdf', type: 'file', size: 1.2e6, date: 'Apr 5' }, { id: 'img3', name: 'team-photo.jpg', type: 'image', size: 3.8e6, date: 'May 12', src: 'data:image/svg+xml,' + encodeURIComponent(' ') }, { id: 'doc2', name: 'meeting-notes.txt', type: 'file', size: 45e3, date: 'Jun 1' }, { id: 'vid2', name: 'tutorial-overview.mov', type: 'video', size: 120e6, date: 'Jun 15' }, { id: 'img4', name: 'brand-logo.svg', type: 'image', size: 120e3, date: 'Jul 1', src: 'data:image/svg+xml,' + encodeURIComponent(' ') }, ];                          Modules 
                        
                         
                            Real CSMA services wired into a local demo flow:
                            auth, notifications, share, and resumable upload.
                         
                     
                 

                 
                     
                         
                            
                             Hybrid 
                         
                         
                            Login, registration, recovery, verification,
                            OAuth simulation, and logout through auth-ui.
                         
                          
                     

                     
                         
                            
                             Consent-aware 
                         
                         
                            Permission requests stay explicit. New items land in
                            the in-app center and can trigger browser delivery
                            when allowed.
                         
                         
                             
                                Request Permission
                             
                             
                                Enqueue Alert
                             
                             
                                Enqueue Warning
                             
                         
                         
                             Center idle 
                             0 unread notifications. 
                         
                          
                     

                     
                         
                            
                             Native + Clipboard 
                         
                         
                            Uses the share module directly. Native share runs
                            first; desktop browsers fall back to clipboard
                            safely.
                         
                         
                             Share text 
                             
                                 
                             
                         
                         
                             
                                Share This Demo
                             
                         
                         
                             Ready 
                             No share request yet. 
                         
                     

                     
                         
                            
                             Resumable 
                         
                         
                            Drop files or browse. Upload state is driven by the
                            real file-upload module with a local mock transport.

import { createDataGrid } from '../src/modules/archetypes/data-grid/index.js'; import { createStatsDashboard } from '../src/modules/archetypes/stats-dashboard/index.js'; import { createEditor } from '../src/modules/archetypes/editor-builder/index.js'; import { createOverlayManager } from '../src/modules/archetypes/overlay-manager/index.js'; // ─── Mock Data ─────────────────────────────────────── const CAMPAIGNS = [ { id: 1, name: 'Welcome Series', status: 'Active', sent: 1240, opens: 432, clicks: 89, date: 'Jul 1' }, { id: 2, name: 'July Promotion', status: 'Active', sent: 3200, opens: 1100, clicks: 234, date: 'Jul 3' }, { id: 3, name: 'Product Launch', status: 'Draft', sent: 0, opens: 0, clicks: 0, date: 'Jul 5' }, { id: 4, name: 'Monthly Digest', status: 'Sent', sent: 5600, opens: 2100, clicks: 450, date: 'Jun 28' }, { id: 5, name: 'Re-engagement', status: 'Active', sent: 890, opens: 120, clicks: 15, date: 'Jul 2' }, { id: 6, name: 'Onboarding Flow', status: 'Draft', sent: 0, opens: 0, clicks: 0, date: 'Jul 6' }, ]; const TEMPLATES = [ { id: 't1', name: 'Welcome Email', type: 'file', meta: 'HTML · 12KB', date: 'Jun 15' }, { id: 't2', name: 'Promo Banner', type: 'image', meta: 'PNG · 240KB', date: 'Jun 20' }, { id: 't3', name: 'Monthly Roundup', type: 'file', meta: 'HTML · 18KB', date: 'Jun 25' }, { id: 't4', name: 'Abandoned Cart', type: 'file', meta: 'HTML · 9KB', date: 'Jul 1' }, ]; // ─── Campaigns Grid ─────────────────────────────────── const campaignsGrid = createDataGrid(document.getElementById('campaigns-grid'), null, { columns: [ { id: 'name', label: 'Campaign', width: 200, sortable: true }, { id: 'status', label: 'Status', width: 90 }, { id: 'sent', label: 'Sent', width: 80, sortable: true }, { id: 'opens', label: 'Opens', width: 80 }, { id: 'clicks', label: 'Clicks', width: 80 }, { id: 'date', label: 'Date', width: 80 }, ], data: CAMPAIGNS, rowHeight: 36, onRowClick: (row) => { overlays.openModal( ` Status: ${row.status}

CAMPAIGNS.unshift({ id: Date.now(), name: data.name, status: 'Draft', sent: 0, opens: 0, clicks: 0, date: 'Today' }); campaignsGrid.update(CAMPAIGNS); }, draftKey: 'newsletter-compose', }); // ─── Nav Tabs (sidebar) ─────────────────────────────── const views = { campaigns: 'view-campaigns', compose: 'view-compose', templates: 'view-templates' }; # CSMA Typeset - Rhythm Demo

Source: demo/typeset-demo.html

## Rhythm Controls
# Architecture Overview
## The 6 Rules
### Token Reference
```
const el = document.querySelector('.card');
el.className = 'card completed';
el.dataset.state = 'loading';
```
| Token | Value | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-xs` | 0.25rem | Tight gaps |
| `--space-md` | 0.75rem | Standard gap |
| `--space-xl` | 1.5rem | Section gaps |
- Size:  15 px 
       
     

     
       Leading:  1.75  
       
     

     
       Flow:  1.25 em 
       
     

     
       Presets 
       Docs 
       Blog 
       Chat 
       Slides 
     

     
       Font 
       
         System (default) 
         Serif 
         Mono 
       
     

     
       Theme 
       
         Dark 
         Light 
       
     
   

   
   
     
       
      
       CSMA separates concerns:  JavaScript manages state via events, CSS handles rendering.  This achieves fast DOM updates and a minimal bundle size. 
       CSMA is  modules-first . Prefer trusted modules under `src/modules/*`, Contracts for validation and security, and lifecycle-safe load/unload through ModuleManager. 

      
       
          State Changes = CSS Classes Only  - no inline styles for UI state
- Define All States in CSS  - use `data-*` attributes
- JavaScript Publishes Events, CSS Handles Rendering
CSMA Typeset - Rhythm Demo CSMA is modules-first. Prefer trusted modules under `src/modules/*`.

A component inside prose can opt out:

This card keeps its own styles - typeset leaves it alone.
